「當 AI 能量化作劃破長夜的彗星——ASUS CES 2026 全球揭幕。」

針對 ASUS 於 CES 2026 推出的全新 AI 戰略，我們以「彗星」為核心符碼，策劃了這支前導預告。影片透過三種極致的動態語彙，具象化現代生活的核心維度：「靈感恣意游弋的創作彗星」、「質地柔軟舒緩的生活彗星」，以及「追求極致效率的工作彗星」。

從游弋、放鬆到高速奔馳，這三股能量在宇宙深處集結，象徵著 AI 力量的深度匯聚，完美勾勒出 ASUS 此次帶來的全方位智慧生態系。這不僅是一場視覺饗宴，更是對未來智慧生活圖景的最強大宣告——無論何種場景，AI 始於人性，歸於全能。

”When AI energy transforms into comets piercing the night — The ASUS CES 2026 Global Unveiling.“

In response to ASUS‘s new AI strategy for CES 2026, we’ve crafted this teaser using ”comets“ as the central symbol. The film utilizes three distinct dynamic languages to embody the core dimensions of modern life: the ”Creative Comet,“ where inspiration drifts freely; the ”Lifestyle Comet,“ with its soft and soothing texture; and the ”Workplace Comet,“ driven by high-speed efficiency.

From drifting and relaxation to high-velocity sprinting, these three energies converge from the depths of the universe. This symbolizes the profound integration of AI power, perfectly outlining the comprehensive smart ecosystem ASUS brings to the world. More than just a visual feast, it is a powerful declaration of the future of intelligent living—no matter the scenario, AI starts with humanity and culminates in omnipotence.

On-the-fly precision tuning is highlighted through quick, tactile adjustments. Rapid cuts of calibration and close-up shots of the keyboard dial emphasize the keyboard’s adaptability in real time.⁠
⁠
Finally, we elevate the E-Sports Pro narrative. A focused gaze in an abstract space, gameplay flickering across his face, cut against arena-scale visuals and product detail. Each shot links the Huntsman V3 Pro’s performance to the mindset it’s built for.⁠
⁠
